Title: When can you play Banner of Neutrality?

Messages.Author: Andrew Daley
Messages.Body:
A search of the newsgroup and errate didn't reveal anything. I thought
that there was some clarification on the WW website.

I am wondering if a tapped vampire can play banner of neutrality?

If so, any reaction card that states it requires a ready "something"
is playable by a tapped vampire?

Andrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Daley wrote:
> A search of the newsgroup and errate didn't reveal anything. I thought
> that there was some clarification on the WW website.

No. It's plays just like Telepathic Counter and other "generic"
reactions cards.

> I am wondering if a tapped vampire can play banner of neutrality?

No.
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec1_6_3

> If so, any reaction card that states it requires a ready "something"
> is playable by a tapped vampire?

No. Reaction cards can be played only by ready untapped minions
(and only during an action being performed by someone else's
minion).

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
dal...@iinet.net.au (Andrew Daley) wrote in message news:<8821ff0a.04083...@posting.google.com>...


Per rulebook section 1.6.3.5 (Definition of a reaction card): "A ready
untapped minion can play a reaction card in response to an action
taken by another Methuselah's minion..."

Therefore, unless a reaction card specifies that it can be played by a
tapped vampire, it cannot - Banner of Neutrality does not have any
such text, so a tapped vampire can't play it.

-John Flournoy
